name: Shin'ainaru Kodoku to Kunou e
original_name: 親愛なる孤独と苦悩へ
source:
Uchida Kisaki, Nako Ryuusuke, and Tomiya Umi—three college students trying to make sense of modern life.
They were stuck.
Dreams, goals, jobs, relationships, family…
And then there were their own personalities, their thoughts, their very selves.
The present felt out of reach, and the future even more so.
At the end of a desperate internet search for "counselor," on the 39th page of results, they stumbled onto something.
A painfully simple website, but with bold, confident claims.
And for some reason, it was free.
This was how they met Tachibana Makoto, a counselor who went by simply "Mako."
What would change in their hearts? What choices would they make? Where would they end up?
Let’s see where it all leads.

[Translated from [url=http://rakusomoku.web.fc2.com/Shinainaru_kodokuto_kunouhe.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
内田喜崎、菜子龙介和富宫海美——三名试图理解现代生活的大学生。
他们被困住了。
梦想、目标、工作、人际关系、家庭……
然后还有他们自己的个性、他们的想法、他们的自我。
现在感觉遥不可及，未来更是如此。
在网上绝望地搜索“辅导员”后，在第39页的结果中，他们偶然发现了一些东西。
一个极其简单的网站，但有着大胆、自信的主张。
由于某种原因，它是免费的。
就这样，他们认识了橘真琴（Tachibana Makoto），一位简称为“真子”的辅导员。
他们的内心会发生什么变化？他们会做出什么选择？他们最终会去哪里？
让我们看看这一切会走向何方。

[翻译自[url=http://rakusomoku.web.fc2.com/Shinainaru_kodokuto_kunouhe.html]官方网站[/url]]
